borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
description: Replacement of existing dormer French doors with new Crittall style dormer French doors, to the rear elevation of existing rear roof extension; installation of a new window and replacement of an existing window, to the rear elevation at first floor level; alterations to the existing single storey rear extension to include, erection of a new flat roof with a rooflight on top to the rear and erection of a new glazed flat roof to the side infill extension following the removal of existing pitched roof, and installation of new Crittall style doors following the removal of existing French doors and side panels to the rear elevation at ground floor level; demolition of existing shed in the rear garden; removal of existing 4no. Olive Trees (T1-T4) and replacement with new potted plants in the front garden; erection of a replacement brick-built front boundary wall including brick piers, and installation of metal railings on top of the low brick wall.
